slices.focus: Initial onboarding: personal background, personality, and professional context
slices.summary: Hannah Louise Mercer (36, Providence RI) introduces herself as a mid-career registrar — quiet stubborn, anxious overpreparer, ISTJ — with a Master's in Museum Studies and a five-year vision to bring the museum's collections records, storage, and loan procedures to 98% verified reliability.
open_loops: None — this is a pure onboarding slice establishing baseline context

slices.focus: Photography loan request exposes widespread records gaps, leading to formal collections integrity review
slices.summary: When a Boston lender asks about a photography loan, Hannah's honest digging reveals unreliable object locations, incomplete files, and prep-room documentation gaps — forcing her to lead a formal collections integrity review.
open_loops: Draft phase-one scope in 'question, findings, risk, phase one' format
Define sample set and failure categories for repeatable testing
Request one clearly delegated support task from leadership
Establish recurring standing check-in instead of ad-hoc chasing
